biggest_catch: You earn only $25 when your friend opens the account — the second $25 requires them to hit all three benchmarks (e-statements, 10 point-of-sale transactions, $500 direct deposit) within 60 days.
catches: Referring member earns $25 when the referred member opens a new share draft checking account, plus another $25 if the referred member meets all three benchmarks within 60 days of account opening: e-statement enrollment, 10 point-of-sale transactions, and $500+ direct deposit.
Referring members limited to $500 in account credit per calendar year.

Referred member must present your referral card at account opening (cards available at SRU FCU branches); referral must be disclosed at account opening; applications through third-party channels are not eligible.
Referred member must be approved for membership and be 18+; both parties 18+; current members must be in good standing.
Account credits applied within 60 calendar days of completion; joint owners not eligible unless they open their own account; offer subject to change or end at any time.

steps: Pick up a referral card at an SRU FCU branch.
Give the card to your friend; they must present it at the time of account opening.
Your friend is approved for membership and opens a new SRU FCU share draft checking account — you earn $25 in account credit.

If your friend meets all three benchmarks within 60 days (e-statement enrollment, 10 point-of-sale transactions, $500+ direct deposit), you earn another $25 — up to $50 per referral, max $500 per calendar year.
